City of San Jose permit PD16-025 (PD Permit, folder year 2016), status Approved, issue date 2017-01-10: "Planned Development Permit to allow up to 188 residential units, a minimum of 108,000 square feet of commercial space, and commercial condominium on a 10.6 gross acre site ---- Notice of Partial Release of a Planned Development Permit - Was requested and" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

City of San Jose permit PD19-010 (PD Permit, folder year 2019), status Approved, issue date 2019-06-11: "Planned Development Permit to effectuate a Conforming Planned Development Zoning District of an approved development for 188 residential units, a minimum of 108,000 square feet of commercial space, and an approximately 43,583 square feet publically access" (city text cut off at 255 characters)
Site is the southwest corner of North Capitol Avenue and Gimelli Way (formerly 641 North Capitol Avenue), about 800 feet from the McKee light rail station, bounded by Interstate 680 to the southwest.

Approved as a Signature Project in the North Capitol Avenue/McKee Road Urban Village: up to 188 residential units, a mixed-use commercial/retail building, an office/commercial building, a mini-storage building, a 0.58-acre public park and 0.45 acres of publicly accessible private recreation.
Vesting Tentative Map PT16-035 subdivided one parcel into six lots and created 188 residential condominium units.
CEQA: determination of consistency with the 641 North Capitol Avenue Mixed-Use Project Mitigated Negative Declaration (Resolution No. 78053).
The staff report's history table dates PDA16-025-01 to March 7, 2018; its text dates the Director Hearing approval to September 26, 2017.
